fullPassage: Though thousands of books have been written about learning, the concept of learning potential remains insufficiently elaborated. One of the possible reasons for such a state of affairs is the tendency to view learning only through its products. When a math or history exam is given to students, it is assumed that the results of the exam will reveal the efficiency of students' previous learning. In other words, what we can see in such an exam is only the result rather than the process of learning. Moreover, such an exam provides us with relatively little information about each student's potential for learning something new. For example, one student can achieve good exam results by investing much more time in learning than another student who achieved the same result. The efficiency of the first one is thus lower than that of the second student, but this factor is "hidden" in a typical exam. The situation is even more complicated in the case of so-called intelligence tests. Some psychologists insist that properly designed intelligence tests tap into the individual's innate abilities that are unrelated to his or her learning experiences. Others, however, define intelligence itself as a "general learning ability" and claim that intelligence tests provide us with a pretty accurate estimate of not only personal knowledge but also the person's learning ability. Irrespective of the definition, however, the results of intelligence tests provide information only about people's current knowledge and problem-solving skills but say little about their learning potential.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시험에서 우리가 볼 수 있는 것은 학습의 결과일 뿐 과정이 아니라는 핵심 대조
det.analysis:
❌ ① the efficiency of the exam itself(시험 자체의 효율): '시험의 효율'이라는 개념은 본문의 논점(시험이 보여주는 것의 한계)과 다름. 시험이 학생의 학습 효율을 드러낸다고 가정한다는 3문장과 혼동 유발

❌ ② the students' innate intelligence(학생의 선천적 지능): innate는 뒷부분 지능 검사 논의에서 등장하며, 4문장(시험이 보여주는 것) 맥락과 부적합

❌ ③ a fair comparison between individuals(개인 간 공정한 비교): 시험의 공정성은 본문의 논점이 아니며, 'only ~ of learning'이라는 구문과 문법적으로 부자연스러움

✅ ④ the result rather than the process(과정이 아닌 결과): 앞 문장의 'reveal the efficiency'에서 시험이 보여주는 것을 환언(In other words)하여, 시험이 학습의 '결과만(only)' 보여주고 '과정은 아니다(rather than)'는 핵심 대비에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: 'In other words(다시 말해)'는 앞 문장을 환언합니다. 시험이 효율을 '드러낸다(reveal)'는 것을 구체화하면 → 결과(result)만 보여주고 과정(process)은 보여주지 못한다는 것입니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시험이 새로운 학습 잠재력에 대해 제공하는 정보가 '비교적 적다'는 한계
det.analysis:

✅ ② relatively little information(비교적 적은 정보): 'Moreover(게다가)'로 시작하는 추가 한계 진술. 시험이 새로운 것을 배울 잠재력에 대해 '비교적 적은 정보를 제공한다'는 점이 앞의 '과정을 보여주지 못함'에 이어지는 추가 제한 ←정답

❌ ③ an accurate measure of potential(잠재력의 정확한 측정): 글의 논점은 시험이 잠재력을 측정하지 '못한다'는 것이므로, '정확한 측정'은 정반대

❌ ④ a comprehensive view of intelligence(지능에 대한 포괄적 관점): 지능(intelligence)은 8문장 이후에서 다루며, 5문장의 '시험이 제공하는 것'의 맥락과 시기적으로 맞지 않음

questions.passage: Though thousands of books have been written about learning, the concept of learning potential remains insufficiently elaborated. One of the possible reasons for such a state of affairs is the tendency to view learning only through its products. When a math or history exam is given to students, it is assumed that the results of the exam will reveal the efficiency of students' previous learning. In other words, what we can see in such an exam is only the result rather than the process of learning. Moreover, such an exam provides us with relatively little information about each student's potential for learning something new. For example, one student can achieve good exam results by investing much more time in learning than another student who achieved the same result. The efficiency of the first one is thus lower than that of the second student, but this factor is "hidden" in a typical exam. The situation is even more complicated in the case of so-called intelligence tests. Some psychologists insist that properly designed intelligence tests tap into the individual's innate abilities that are unrelated to his or her learning experiences. Others, however, define intelligence itself as a "general learning ability" and claim that intelligence tests provide us with a pretty accurate estimate of not only personal knowledge but also the person's learning ability. Irrespective of the definition, however, the results of intelligence tests provide information only about people's current knowledge and problem-solving skills but say little about their learning potential.

questions.passage: Though thousands of books have been written about learning, the concept of learning potential remains insufficiently elaborated. One of the possible reasons for such a state of affairs is the tendency to view learning only through its products. When a math or history exam is given to students, it is assumed that the results of the exam will reveal the efficiency of students' previous learning. In other words, what we can see in such an exam is only the result rather than the process of learning. Moreover, such an exam provides us with relatively little information about each student's potential for learning something new. For example, one student can achieve good exam results by investing much more time in learning than another student who achieved the same result. The efficiency of the first one is thus lower than that of the second student, but this factor is "hidden" in a typical exam. The situation is even more complicated in the case of so-called intelligence tests. Some psychologists insist that properly designed intelligence tests tap into the individual's innate abilities that are unrelated to his or her learning experiences. Others, however, define intelligence itself as a "general learning ability" and claim that intelligence tests provide us with a pretty accurate estimate of not only personal knowledge but also the person's learning ability. Irrespective of the definition, however, the results of intelligence tests provide information only about people's current knowledge and problem-solving skills but say little about their learning potential.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 학습 잠재력의 개념이 충분히 정교화되지 못한 이유 중 하나로 제시된, 학습을 바라보는 방식의 특성을 설명하는 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (영어로, 7단어)

det.korean: 2문장에 'the tendency to view learning only through its products'라고 명시되어 있습니다.
det.analysis: 2문장에서 학습 잠재력 미정립의 원인으로 '학습을 그 결과물을 통해서만 보려는 경향(the tendency to view learning only through its products)'이 제시됨. to부정사(to view) + 목적어(learning) + 부사(only) + 전치사구(through its products)의 7단어가 학습을 바라보는 방식의 특성을 설명하는 표현
det.tip: 'to view learning only through its products'는 학습의 결과물(시험 점수 등)만으로 학습을 평가하려는 편향을 나타냅니다. only가 핵심 한정어입니다.

questions.stem: 위 글에서 지능의 정의와 무관하게 지능 검사 결과가 제공하는 정보의 범위와 한계를 동시에 보여주는 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (영어로, 8단어)

det.korean: 마지막 문장에 'the results of intelligence tests provide information only about people's current knowledge and problem-solving skills but say little about their learning potential'이라고 명시되어 있습니다.
det.analysis: 마지막 문장에서 지능 검사가 보여주는 것(current knowledge and problem-solving skills)과 보여주지 못하는 것(say little about learning potential)의 경계를 나타내는 표현. 형용사(current) + 명사(knowledge) + 접속사(and) + 명사(problem-solving skills) + 접속사(but) + 동사구(say little)의 8단어 구조. but를 기점으로 '보여주는 것'과 '한계'가 대비됨
det.tip: 'but say little about ~'는 '~에 대해서는 거의 말해주지 못한다'는 한계를 나타냅니다. current(현재)가 핵심: 지능 검사는 '현재' 상태만 보여줄 뿐 '잠재력'은 보여주지 못합니다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로, 7단어)
"학습에 훨씬 더 많은 시간을 투자함으로써"
[조건] (1) by, in, investing, learning, more, much, time을 모두 사용

det.korean: 6문장에 'one student can achieve good exam results by investing much more time in learning'에서 발췌한 표현입니다.
det.analysis: 전치사(by) + 동명사(investing) + 부사(much) + 비교급(more) + 명사(time) + 전치사(in) + 동명사(learning) 구조. 'by + 동명사'는 '~함으로써'라는 수단/방법을 나타내는 구문이며, much more는 비교급 강조 부사
det.tip: 'by + 동명사(~함으로써)'는 수단/방법을 나타내는 전치사 구문입니다. much는 비교급 more를 강조하는 부사로, 'much more time(훨씬 더 많은 시간)'을 만듭니다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로, 8단어)
"우리에게 꽤 정확한 추정치를 제공하다"
[조건] (1) a, accurate, estimate, of, pretty, provide, us, with를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 10문장에 'intelligence tests provide us with a pretty accurate estimate of not only personal knowledge but also the person's learning ability'에서 발췌한 표현입니다.
det.analysis: 동사(provide) + 간접목적어(us) + 전치사(with) + 관사(a) + 부사(pretty) + 형용사(accurate) + 명사(estimate) + 전치사(of) 구조. 'provide A with B(A에게 B를 제공하다)' 이중목적어 구문에서 B = a pretty accurate estimate of ~(~의 꽤 정확한 추정치)
det.tip: 'provide + 간접목적어 + with + 직접목적어'는 '~에게 ~을 제공하다'라는 구문입니다. pretty는 '꽤, 상당히'라는 정도 부사로 accurate를 수식합니다.
